review_basis:
Eleventh golden, found via the same text-anchored discovery method as Run 34's own golden: reading a sheet's own real text for a size/system callout, then looking at a render crop, before ever attempting a coordinate search. `013_MO_T2523_01_Replace_Boilers_Phase_2_Building_29.pdf` (a Missouri Army National Guard project, 1107th Theater Aviation Sustainment Maintenance Group, Springfield, MO -- explicitly a narrow-scope 'Replace Boilers' project, matching Run 31's own targeting refinement) sheet M-122 ('PARTIAL MECHANICAL PLAN - AREA C-3') is a real, sparse, legible new-construction mechanical plan showing real HHWS/HHWR (heating hot water supply/return) piping serving three AHU units (7030A, 7010A, 7015A) fed from a boiler plant.

A real text search for `HHWR`/`HHWS` found several candidates; the two used here are a matched parallel 6-inch HHWS/HHWR riser pair, both real automatic binds (`size-binding:beside`, `pipe:6in`), each with one clean `dead_end` and one `ambiguous` stop. A marked render crop confirms both real physical boundaries directly: the `dead_end` end (top) sits exactly on a real drawn break-line symbol with the sheet's own printed 'REFER TO M-121 SHEET FOR CONTINUATION' leader pointing directly at it -- a real, disclosed cross-sheet continuation boundary, the same convention this project's own goldens already use for cut/continuation points. The `ambiguous` end (bottom) sits exactly at a real elbow where the vertical riser turns to run horizontally along a header serving multiple downstream AHU branch connections (each individually labeled '6"') -- a genuine real fork, not an engine misread, the same category Run 34's own golden established as a legitimate scope boundary. Both runs' own bench-style reseed (40% into the single segment, the bench's own `seedOnLongestSegment` convention) was independently re-verified live and reproduces each result identically.
scope: Two real 6-inch heating hot water pipe risers (a matched HHWS/HHWR supply/return pair, ~74-76 LF each) on a Missouri National Guard boiler-replacement project's own Partial Mechanical Plan - Area C-3, sheet M-122, each from a real cross-sheet continuation break-line (top) to a real elbow into a multi-branch AHU header (bottom). Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the continuation of both pipes onto sheet M-121 (real, disclosed, printed on the sheet itself, not sampled here); the header's own downstream 6" branch connections to AHU-7030A and the other AHU units past each riser's own elbow; the smaller 3"/4" HHWS/HHWR branches visible in the same crop feeding AHU-7010A and AHU-7015A; every other run on this real 28-sheet plan set (only sheet 11/M-122 sampled); every other candidate this file's own text search surfaced but not yet authored into a golden.
